'''Hissest''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sekct]] who encountered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents while fighting a pack of [[Mosrk'teck]]. She attempted to convince [[She-Who-Speaks (Hissest's tribe)|the leader]] of [[Hissest's tribe|her tribe]] to aid the Rebels in destroying a [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|hyperbaride plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. [[She-Who-Speaks]] was outraged by Hissest's belief that the Rebels were some form of divine aid and ordered that the Rebels undergo "[[trial by challenge]]," a duel to the [[Death/Legends|death]] between appointed champions. Hissest was appointed as the Sekct champion. The outcome of the duel elevated Hissest in the eyes of the tribe, and she became the de facto chief, eventually replacing the previous She-Who-Speaks.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
If Hissest ends up the duel's victor, then she becomes the tribe's She-Who-Speaks. If she is [[Death/Legends|killed]], then the original She-Who-Speaks will consider the Rebels friends for honoring her tradition.
